name: congress
description: Number of the Congress, e.g. 115 for the 115th Congress (2017-2019)
observations: Ordinal Congress number, starting at 1 in 1789. Each Congress spans two years. Partition column of the partitioned tables

name: chamber
description: Chamber: House, Senate or President

name: icpsr
description: ICPSR identifier of the member
observations: In general one identifier per member for their whole career. Members who switched parties, and members who later became president, receive a new identifier so that a separate NOMINATE estimate can be produced. Use bioguide_id to identify the person

name: state_icpsr
description: ICPSR code of the state the member represents
observations: ICPSR state codes. 92-96 are territories (PR, AS, GU, MP, VI) and 99 is the whole country (presidents). The state directory has no ICPSR code for territories, so the directory link is on state_abbrev

name: district_code
description: Congressional district the member represents within their state
observations: 0 for senators and presidents. Historical at-large districts are coded 99, 98 or 1

name: state_abbrev
description: Two-letter postal abbreviation of the state the member represents
observations: USA for presidents, which is not in the state directory

name: party_code
description: Voteview code of the member's party
observations: Party names are in the parties table (congress, chamber, party_code)

name: occupancy
description: ICPSR occupancy code: order of the member among the occupants of the seat
observations: 0 if the only occupant, 1 if the first, 2 if the second, and so on. Legacy ICPSR field, not verified by Voteview

name: last_means
description: ICPSR attain-office code: the member's last means of attaining office
observations: Legacy ICPSR field, not verified by Voteview

name: bioname
description: Name of the member, surname first

name: bioguide_id
description: Identifier of the member in the Biographical Directory of the US Congress

name: born
description: Year of the member's birth

name: died
description: Year of the member's death

name: nominate_dim1
description: NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) first-dimension estimate
observations: Ideal-point coordinate, roughly between -1 and 1. The first dimension is usually read as economic liberal (negative) to conservative (positive). Re-estimated over the whole history when new votes arrive, so past values can change between releases

name: nominate_dim2
description: NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) second-dimension estimate
observations: Ideal-point coordinate, roughly between -1 and 1. The first dimension is usually read as economic liberal (negative) to conservative (positive). Re-estimated over the whole history when new votes arrive, so past values can change between releases

name: nominate_log_likelihood
description: Log-likelihood of the member's NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) estimate

name: nominate_geo_mean_probability
description: Geometric mean probability of the member's NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) estimate

name: nominate_number_of_votes
description: Number of votes cast by the member in the Congress

name: nominate_number_of_errors
description: Number of the member's votes misclassified by the NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) estimate

name: conditional
description: Whether the NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) estimate was produced conditionally
observations: Conditional estimates are provisional and are updated at the next full estimation. Empty in every row of the current release

name: nokken_poole_dim1
description: Nokken-Poole first-dimension estimate
observations: Estimated separately for each Congress, unlike nominate_dim1

name: nokken_poole_dim2
description: Nokken-Poole second-dimension estimate
observations: Estimated separately for each Congress, unlike nominate_dim2
